articles.title: Djokovic recovers from a tough start to extend Beijing winning run
articles.summary: Novak Djokovic beat Bu Yunchaokete in nearly three hours to reach the China Open's third round. Aryna Sabalenka also advanced with a 6-1, 6-3 opening victory.

articles.title: Pikachu's space trip connects Pokémon with a science exhibition
articles.summary: ESA reported that a Pikachu plush orbited Earth about 1,040 times during its space station stay. A travelling exhibition combines Pokémon characters with real space science.

articles.title: Romania's record recycled table raises funds for children's hospital
articles.summary: A 4.99-kilometer table made from recycled materials set a Guinness World Record in Bucharest. Its community meal raised more than $110,000 for specialist children's care.
